description: This file defines the LeadsJjwg_MapsLogicHook class which implements logic hooks related to geocoding functionalities within the Leads module, interacting with the jjwg_Maps module settings and methods.

classes.name: LeadsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: Class implementing logic hooks for managing geocode information updates for leads and related meetings, based on jjwg_Maps module settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeadsJjwg_MapsLogicHook object and retrieves module info for jjwg_Maps.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Callable before saving a lead; updates geocode information if logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Callable after saving a lead; updates related meetings' geocode information if enabled.
